label: era6-n1
_why: FIRST RUN OF THE RE-BANDED LADDER AS SHIPPED. 106 tiers on the ruled anchors 1750/1830/1870/1900/1925/1940, every tier gated by its own technology (54 new ones), every technology covered by journal entries (138 covered, 414 entries), every rung requiring the rung below it, and — after the date-gate fix — every era-N rung present in its own era-N scenario (30 absences down to the 2 ruled ERA_PRUNE exemptions). Fixing the converter's tier mapping as a side effect of dropping the seven ~1700 rungs also made the 1836 start actually re-tier for the first time.
_arms: era6 = {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.json} — the re-banded 106-tier ladder is now THE canonical config; the .era6 side files are merged and deleted. research_events.enabled: true, so this is the techs+events arm.
_comparison: Against run002 of 20260812_093402_research-events-fixed-n2, which is the same arm (techs+events, fixed military gate, vanilla ahead-of-time penalty) on the OLD 100-tier ladder. ⚠ THE TWO DIFFER IN MORE THAN THE LADDER: 15 new technologies deepen the production tree, which raises the ahead-of-time penalty on everything above them, and 15 more journal entries exist to be filled. This run cannot separate 'the re-band' from 'a deeper tree' and is not meant to.
_watch: FIRST: that it runs. 106 tier buildings, 40 emitted for the first time, and an 1836 start that now genuinely re-tiers (textile, furniture, paper, glass and tooling split across rungs where they used to pass through). Smoke-check at five minutes per the hard rule: init marker, game version, this run's own error window, clock advancing. THEN: whether the new rungs are ever built; era-5 technologies held by the leader at 1935 against batch A's 17/17 production and 15/15 military, and the year it reaches half of era 5 against batch A's 1913-1917 and the 1940 anchor.
_caveats: GAME VERSION 1.13.10, against batch A's 1.13.9 — three of that hotfix's fixes touch quantities this mod is calibrated against (private investment no longer endlessly expands unprofitable railways, shipyard wages no longer paid twice, a single-good shortage now lowers organization instead of draining supply). So this run measures a new ladder AND a changed game, and cannot separate them. The era-1 employment threshold (5000) is provisional and unruled. building_cost is now solved for all 106 tiers.
